title: Tomato Basil Pasta
description: Weeknight pasta that leans on canned tomatoes and a bunch of basil.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Warm the olive oil and soften the onion and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for about 8 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and tear in the basil. Add parmesan if you have it.

title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
description: A one-pot curry with chickpeas, coconut milk, and spinach over rice.
instructions: Rinse the rice and start it cooking.
Soften the onion, garlic, and ginger in olive oil. Stir in the cumin.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold in the spinach, finish with lemon, and serve over rice.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Fast shrimp in butter, garlic, and lemon.
instructions: Pat the shrimp dry.
Melt the butter and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and cook until just pink, about 2 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon. Scatter parsley if you have it.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Eggs, rice, and whatever vegetables are still good.
instructions: Cook the rice if it is not already cooked, then let it cool a little.
Scramble the eggs in oil and set them aside.
Cook the onion, carrot, pepper, and garlic until just tender.
Return the rice and eggs, add soy sauce, and toss until hot.

title: Chicken Soy Stir-Fry
description: Chicken and peppers in a quick soy and ginger sauce.
instructions: Start the rice.
Slice the chicken and vegetables.
Sear the chicken in oil, then add onion, pepper, garlic, and ginger.
Pour in the soy sauce and cook until the chicken is done. Serve over rice.

title: Red Lentil Soup
description: A thick soup of lentils, carrot, and tomato.
instructions: Soften the onion, carrot, and garlic in olive oil.
Stir in the cumin, lentils, tomatoes, and 800 ml water.
Simmer for about 25 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Season and finish with lemon.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Stirred rice with mushrooms, butter, and parmesan.
instructions: Warm the stock in a saucepan.
Brown the mushrooms in olive oil and set them aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in butter, add the rice, and stir for a minute.
Add stock a ladle at a time until the rice is tender. Fold in mushrooms and parmesan.

title: Black Bean Tacos
description: Warm tortillas with cumin black beans and onion.
instructions: Cook the onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add the beans and cumin and warm through, mashing a few beans.
Heat the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill the tortillas and finish with lemon.

title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Salmon
description: Salmon, broccoli, and lemon on one tray.
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss the broccoli with oil and garlic on a tray.
Nestle in the salmon and lay over lemon slices.
Roast for 15 to 18 minutes, until the salmon flakes.

title: Skillet Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a pepper and tomato skillet.
instructions: Soften the onion, pepper, and garlic in olive oil.
Add cumin and tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs. Cover until the whites set.
Serve from the skillet. Toast bread if you want something to scoop with.

title: Caprese Toast
description: Bread, tomato, mozzarella, and basil. Almost no cooking.
instructions: Toast the bread.
Slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Layer them on the toast with basil.
Drizzle with olive oil.

title: Weeknight Beef Chili
description: Ground beef, black beans, and tomato, simmered until thick.
instructions: Brown the beef with onion in a little oil.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin.
Stir in tomatoes and black beans.
Simmer for about 30 minutes until thick.

title: Tofu Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Crisped tofu with broccoli, ginger, and rice.
instructions: Cook the rice. Press and cube the tofu.
Brown the tofu in oil and set it aside.
Stir-fry broccoli, carrot, garlic, and ginger.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce, and serve over rice.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: A small batch of pancakes from banana, oats, and eggs.
instructions: Mash the banana and stir in oats, eggs, and milk. Rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a little butter in a pan.
Cook small pancakes until bubbles set, then flip.
Serve as soon as the centers are cooked through.

title: Peanut Butter Noodles
description: Cold or warm noodles with a peanut and soy sauce.
instructions: Boil the noodles and drain them.
Stir peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic, and lemon juice with a splash of hot water.
Toss the noodles in the sauce.
Add sliced cucumber if you have it.

title: Roasted Chickpea Bowl
description: Sweet potato, chickpeas, and spinach with lemon.
instructions: Heat the oven to 210°C.
Cube the sweet potato and toss with chickpeas, oil, garlic, and cumin.
Roast for about 25 minutes.
Fold through spinach so it wilts, and finish with lemon.

title: Tuna White Bean Salad
description: A no-cook plate of tuna, beans, onion, and lemon.
instructions: Drain the tuna and beans.
Slice the onion thinly.
Toss everything with olive oil and lemon.
Add parsley if you have it.

title: Spinach Cheddar Frittata
description: Baked eggs with spinach, onion, and cheddar.
instructions: Heat the oven to 190°C.
Soften the onion and garlic in an oven-safe pan, then wilt the spinach.
Pour in beaten eggs and scatter cheddar on top.
Bake for about 15 minutes until just set.

title: Tomato Soup and Cheese Toast
description: A simple tomato soup with cheddar toast on the side.
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in half the butter.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in milk and blend if you like it smooth.
Toast the bread, butter it, and cover with cheddar.
Grill or broil until the cheese melts. Serve with the soup.

title: Coconut Rice and Beans
description: Rice cooked in coconut milk with black beans and cumin.
instructions: Soften the onion and garlic in oil. Stir in cumin.
Add rice, coconut milk, and 200 ml water. Cover and cook until the rice is tender.
Fold in the black beans and heat through.
Rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken
description: Pan chicken with lemon, garlic, rice, and spinach.
instructions: Start the rice.
Season the chicken and brown it in olive oil. Add garlic.
Squeeze over the lemon, add a splash of water, and cover until cooked through.
Wilt the spinach in the pan juices and serve with rice.

title: Potato Leek Soup
description: A quiet soup of potato, leek, and onion.
instructions: Slice the leeks and rinse them well.
Cook leek, onion, and garlic in butter until soft.
Add potato and stock. Simmer until the potato is tender.
Blend until smooth, or leave it chunky.

title: Yogurt Berry Cups
description: Breakfast or a light supper: yogurt, oats, and berries.
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with berries and a little honey.
Add banana or oats if you want more to eat.
